messages:
maria: Drafting release notes for Thu deploy window (2026-03-26 23:00-00:00 PT). Need: canary lanes, model pin, fallback model, brief rollback playbook, and final RN copy for comms. Who's available to review?
noah: Canary lanes: prod-canary-alpha (eng), mobile-canary-beta (mobile), apac-canary. Recommend pin to model:v1.9.0-quant2 for initial canary.
viv: Confirm pin ok for canary. Fallback suggestion: model:v1.8.2-quant (stable). Rollback triggers: 2x baseline error rate for 10m OR p95 latency > 1.5s for 10m OR automated eval regression >4% on core prompts.
jordan: I'll own the internal announce sequence. Planning two blasts: staged internal (eng+prod) 1h before window, then company-wide internal-only 15m before if no red flags. Need final RN by Wed 18:00 PT to prep subject + embargo.
maria: Ops, please run a deploybot simulate to validate manifests and canary pools. Post command you used so comms can reference the preview link.
ops-bot: Suggested command: /deploy simulate release/2026-03-26 --canary prod-canary-alpha --pin model:v1.9.0-quant2
deploy-bot: Received simulate command from ops-bot. Validating...
deploy-bot: Manifests OK; quota check OK; canary pools: prod 2 GPUs free, mobile 1 GPU free, apac 2 GPUs free.
deploy-bot: Preview URL: https://deploy.internal/preview/1772234567-sim
viv: Nice. One more ops request: set rollout policy `pin_model: true` and lock quantizer to avoid runtime swapping during canary. Add that to RN bullets.
maria: Added notes: pin_model true + quant lock. Also adding observability links and a short cost note. Can someone calculate estimated cost delta?
jordan: Quick calc from infra: v1.9.0-quant2 expected ~8% token cost savings vs baseline; include as "approx -8% token cost" in RN. Dashboards: https://console.redwood/dashboards/release-1772234567
noah: a11y and l10n notes: include keyboard navigation checklist and alt text for screenshots. L10n: we'll blast en-US and en-GB only this cycle, other locales deferred. Add link to accessibility report template.
maria: Draft RN link: https://docs/internal/rn/drafts/1772234567-1 (work-in-progress). Please add short rollback playbook (owners + commands) to RN.
viv: Rollback playbook (short): 1) SRE disable canary traffic -> `redwood traffic disable --canary prod-canary-alpha` (sre). 2) Ops revert model pin -> `redwood deploy set-model --pin model:v1.8.2-quant` (noah). 3) Run smoke tests: `./scripts/smoke_release.sh` and confirm p95 < 1s (viv). Approvers for rollback: viv + noah.
sre-oncall: Change window approved by oncall. Pager thresholds set; oncall will monitor core metrics and alert if rollback conditions hit.
jordan: Who will post the eng/product threads? I can post eng+product. @maria can you queue company-wide internal-only blast 15m before window if green?
maria: Yep I can queue company blast. Reminder: subject must include [INTERNAL] and DO NOT FORWARD.
deploy-bot: Simulated traffic numbers: p95=0.9s, error rate=0.3%, eval-set delta=+0.1% (no degradation). No blockers.
noah: Ops note: add `max_canary_traffic: 5%` to rollout policy for faster rollback ability. Also document who has permission to toggle traffic in RN.
maria: Good call. Added `max_canary_traffic: 5%` and permissions section. Final reviewers: viv (a11y + rollback), noah (ops), jordan (comms). Please sign off by Wed 18:00 PT. We'll do final sync Wed 18:30 for go/no-go. :white_check_mark:
